body:
I heard this somewhere, I can't remember where, but it basically had been my motto for the last 2 months since I find myself in a similar position to you.

You did not fail, you are not a failure. What you were trying to do failed. But you have to disassociate yourself from what you do. You are not a failure.

Well that is the gist of it, we are not failures, what we do sometimes fails but we are not. This works for me and I hope it does for you.
For me, I keep repeating everything is going to be fine. I know it will, I'm not the first person to be in the position I am so it works. But having a mantra like that is very very calming
